top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a lucid, bounded virus-like-particle vaccine principle with direct, durable, established prevention of HPV infection and related cancers. Limiting credit to foundational VLP vaccine work makes the Lowy-Frazer-Schiller allocation more defensible than broader formulations that would encompass trials, manufacturing, implementation, or delivery.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile.
